GTA 6 Launch Trailer dropped 1 month ago today.

3 days left until launch ⏳

The GTA 6 banner at Rockstar’s HQ in Edinburgh, Scotland is now complete.

(RDR2 - 2018)            (GTA 6 - 2026)

From adding GTA 6 to our wishlists to counting down the final hours.

What a journey it’s been.

GTA 6 marketing has rolled out in even MORE cities around the world:

- Dortmund, Germany 🇩🇪
- Milan, Italy 🇮🇹
- Manchester, UK 🇬🇧
- Dublin, Ireland 🇮🇪
- Rotterdam, Netherlands 🇳🇱
- Auckland, New Zealand 🇳🇿
- Antwerp, Belgium 🇧🇪
- Helsinki, Finland 🇫🇮

There’s also additional

Twitch has developed new ad technology to help streamers earn more from GTA 6

Brands can now avoid placing ads alongside specific parts of the game they don’t want to be associated with
À titre de comparaison, GTA V affiche 69 missions dans son suivi de progression, dont 4 assassinats optionnels de Lester.

A GTA 6 fan rented a hotel room for a whole week just to play the game all day without being bothered:

“My wife thinks I’m crazy or unfaithful.”

(via u/Impossible_Bus_2319)

GTA VI demanderait environ 50 h pour l’histoire et 200 h pour le platine 🤯

Près de 100 missions, 5 chapitres et 170 espèces animales à scanner, selon Tom Henderson (Insider Gaming).

Perso, je vais déjà perdre 50 h à me balader 😂
Last 3 days until the world plays Grand Theft Auto VI
